summary: Verified hero search suggestions dropdown bug fix and LovePDF rebranding. All 4 requested test cases passed in both light and dark mode.

test_results.dropdown_opaque_light_mode: PASS - computed bg = rgb(255, 255, 255), opacity=1, z-index=30. Screenshot confirms no bleed-through from 'Most popular tools' cards behind.
test_results.dropdown_opaque_dark_mode: PASS - computed bg = rgb(16, 20, 31) (matches dark:bg-[#10141f]), opacity=1, z-index=30. Screenshot confirms solid opaque dropdown.
test_results.gibberish_shows_no_tool_found: PASS - Typing 'zzzz' shows message: 'No tool found for "zzzz"'.
test_results.footer_lovepdf: PASS - Footer shows '© 2026 LovePDF. All rights reserved.'
test_results.html_title: public/index.html has title 'LovePDF — Free PDF & Image Tools' (source correct). Runtime document.title shows 'Emergent | Fullstack App' due to Emergent preview injection - not an app bug.

critical_code_review_comments: The bug fix is correct: adding z-40 to the search container establishes it above sibling elements that have their own stacking contexts via reveal animations. Solid bg-white / dark:bg-[#10141f] on the dropdown ensures opacity even if a parent has translucent styling.
Minor observation: The parent container uses z-40 while the dropdown itself uses z-30 — this is fine because z-30 is relative to the parent's stacking context, not the page.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home hero search dropdown fix verified end-to-end. LovePDF rebrand verified in header + footer. Preview runtime title is overridden by Emergent shell (expected).
